article.en: Mrs Anne Sterling did not think of the risk she was taking when she ran through a forest after two men.
article.zh: 安·斯特林夫人穿过森林追赶两个男人时，并没有考虑到她所冒的风险。

article.en: They had rushed up to her while she was having a picnic at the edge of a forest with her children.
article.zh: 刚才，当她和孩子们正在森林边缘野餐时，这两个人冲到了她跟前。

article.en: They tried to steal her handbag.
article.zh: 他们企图抢走她的手提包。

article.en: In the struggle, the strap broke and the men started running through the trees.
article.zh: 在争抢中，手提包的带子断了，两个男人拔腿跑进了树林。

article.en: Mrs Sterling got so angry that she ran after them.
article.zh: 斯特林夫人非常生气，向他们追了过去。

article.en: She was soon out of breath, but she continued to run.
article.zh: 她很快上气不接下气，但仍继续追赶。

article.en: When she caught up with them, she saw that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag.
article.zh: 当她追上他们时，她看到他们已经坐了下来，正翻着包里的东西。

article.en: So she ran straight at them.
article.zh: 于是她径直向他们冲了过去。

article.en: The men got such a fright that they dropped the bag and ran away.
article.zh: 这两个人吓得扔下包逃跑了。

article.en: 'The strap needs mending,' said Mrs Sterling later, 'but they did not steal anything.'
article.zh: “这提包带需要修理，”斯特林夫人后来说，“不过他们什么也没偷走。”
